title: Nashville Retreat with pool, hot tub, & king bed!
description:
Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway. Everything you need is on site. Your dog will enjoy the fenced dog park. Watch the birds & wildlife & sip coffee from the 2nd story balcony. The hot tub is open year round. The pool opens April to October. Washer/dryer, central heat and air, and parking in the driveway, shared only with the owner, who resides in the lower half of the home.
10 minutes to restaurants and shops in Smyrna, 25 minutes to downtown Nashville, 25 minutes to Franklin

The space
The home is a 3000 sq ft residence in a rural suburban quiet neighborhood. The AIRBNB unit is the entire 2nd floor, encompassing 1200 sq ft with 2 bedrooms, 1 bath, living, dining, kitchen & laundry room, with a large private second story balcony, with chairs, overlooking the pool, hot tub ,& the back yard. Airbnb unit has a private exterior entrance. There is a patio with grill and tables. Pool has lounge chairs on deck.
     Owner’s on site on first floor. Nothing is shared other than the driveway & there is ample space to park.

Guest access
Guests have their own outdoor stairway to second floor, with view of pool & hot tub, patio & back yard.
